translations.web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
translations.bsb: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
translations.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
translations.asv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
